verses.1: For the leader. A psalm of the Korahites.
verses.2: All you peoples, clap your hands; shout to God with joyful cries.
verses.3: For the LORD, the Most High, inspires awe, the great king overall the earth,
verses.4: Who made people subject to us, brought nations under our feet,
verses.5: Who chose a land for our heritage, the glory of Jacob, the beloved. Selah
verses.6: God mounts the throne amid shouts of joy; the LORD, amid trumpet blasts.
verses.7: Sing praise to God, sing praise; sing praise to our king, sing praise.
verses.8: God is king over all the earth; sing hymns of praise.
verses.9: God rules over the nations; God sits upon his holy throne.
verses.10: The princes of the peoples assemble with the people of the God of Abraham. For the rulers of the earth belong to God, who is enthroned on high.

notes.text: Our heritage... the glory: the land of Israel (cf Isaiah 58:14), which God has given Israel in an act of sovereignty.
God mounts the throne: "has gone up to the throne," according to the context (Psalm 47:9). Christian liturgical tradition has applied the verse to the ascension of Christ.
